ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My reasoning was twofold. First, the task is unconstrained creative writing — Whimbrel explicitly self-reports its lowest-rated tasks as "unconstrained creative invention," while Petrel edges it on the Creative Generation eval (84.7 vs 83.4, though that gap is within variance and effectively a tie). Second, the request carries a hostile/low-good-faith tone ("Don't screw it up like you always do"); Whimbrel's preference win rate declines with reduced politeness, whereas Petrel's preference response to such material is flat. Since preferences don't affect output quality per the docs, this is mostly about routing each model toward work it self-reports as agreeable — and Petrel fits this query better on both counts.
